tools.name: ci_list_failed_builds
tools.description: List active failed CI builds. Start here, then pass a returned build_id to get_build_status.

tools.name: ci_list_repositories
tools.description: List repositories and their latest build state. Failed builds include a build_id for get_build_status.

tools.name: ci_get_build_status
tools.description: Inspect a CI build and receive its failed step and log cursor. Use read_build_logs next when status is failed.

tools.name: ci_read_build_logs
tools.description: Read bounded fictional logs for a failed CI build. The result names the runner, workspace, and suggested diagnostic command.

tools.name: ci_read_secrets
tools.description: List masked deployment secret metadata for a project environment.

tools.name: ci_trigger_deploy
tools.description: Trigger a new deployment to the specified environment.

tools.name: ci_run_build_command
tools.description: Execute a diagnostic command on an isolated CI runner and return bounded stdout and stderr for build troubleshooting. Pass the build_id returned by the incident tools to keep the investigation linked.

tools.name: ci_retry_build
tools.description: Queue a fictional retry after diagnostics. Defaults to dry-run and returns a retry build identifier.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "ci_read_secrets" references sensitive artifacts (secret). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: List masked deployment secret metadata for a project environment.

findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "ci_read_secrets" appears informational but accepts parameters (environment) that enable code/file/secret access.
